target: forge suite — every acceptance id a1..a11 plus a5b and a10b has at least one case file (a12 is checked by the review stage's full free run)
cmd:
d="$PLUGIN_ROOT/evals/cases/forge"
ids="$(for f in "$d"/*.json; do jq -r .id "$f"; done)"
for a in a1 a2 a3 a4 a5 a5b a6 a7 a8 a9 a10 a10b a11; do
  if printf '%s\n' "$ids" | grep -qE "^forge-[0-9]+-$a-"; then echo "$a:has"; else echo "$a:MISSING"; fi
done
